cases.sentence: В одиннадцатом году, в первый день ___ было ко мне слово Господа:
cases.explain: «третьего месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

cases.explain: «ливанский кедр» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

cases.sentence: Все ___ разместились на мертвом стволе; все дикие звери расселились среди его веток.
cases.explain: «небесные птицы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches;

cases.sentence: Все небесные птицы разместились на мертвом стволе; все ___ расселились среди его веток.
cases.explain: «дикие звери» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches;

cases.sentence: Все это было для того, чтобы ___ у воды впредь не поднимались так высоко и не возносили вершину к облакам; чтобы другие деревья, которые пьют воду, не достигали такой высоты.
cases.explain: «другие деревья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’

cases.sentence: Какое из ___ могло сравниться с тобой славой и величием?
cases.explain: «эдемских деревьев» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “ ‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “ ‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

cases.sentence: Но и тебя вслед за ___ сведут в мир мертвых; ты будешь лежать среди необрезанных, рядом с теми, кто пал от меча.
cases.explain: «эдемскими деревьями» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “ ‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “ ‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
